move: FAB press morphs to X, options stagger up with back ease, close reverses
how: A phone mock with a list, a blurred scrim, a blue FAB and three hidden option rows (label plus icon) above it. Cursor arrives with power3.out over the first 15% of the 4s loop. Press at 0.6s: FAB scales 0.88 with power2.in, then at 0.72s rebounds to 1.08 with elastic.out(1,0.5) while its borderRadius rounds from 24px to 34px and the plus icon rotates 135deg with back.out(2). The scrim fades in over 0.4s and the three options rise from y 30 / scale 0.6 to rest with back.out(2.2), staggered 0.08s from the end (nearest the FAB first). The cursor drifts to hover the middle option, which nudges 6px left and back. At 3.0s (75%) the cursor re-presses the FAB: options drop away with power3.in staggered 0.05, the icon spins back, radius returns to 24px, scrim fades, and the cursor exits by 3.9s.
adapt: Change the three option labels and icons, the blue accent, the list placeholder contents and the phone frame. Keep the press/rebound timing and the from-end stagger so the menu appears to grow out of the FAB.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the phone, list, scrim, menu options, FAB and cursor inside el. animate returns the same timeline at fractions of D (open press 0.15D, options 0.195D, hover 0.4D to 0.625D, close 0.75D, exit 0.85D). Scope '.opt', '.fab', '.scrim', '.cursor' to el; fx0/fy0 are derived from the 340x680 phone size and should come from the FAB's offset instead.
caveats: borderRadius tweened as a string value
